title: Add a product to the cart from product details
description: This test verifies that a shopper can add a product from its details page and see it reflected in the cart flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Click a product card to open its details
Add the product to the cart
Verify the product is added to the cart

title: Complete guest checkout with cash on delivery
description: This verifies that a guest shopper can place an order with name, phone number, address, and cash on delivery payment.

steps.description: Navigate to /checkout
Add a product to the cart from the shopping flow
Enter a full name
Enter a valid phone number
Enter a valid address
Select cash on delivery as the payment method
Submit the checkout form
Verify the order confirmation is visible
Verify the order is created successfully

title: Browse featured products from the home page
description: This test verifies that a guest shopper can see featured watches on the landing page and open a product detail page from there.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify featured products are displayed
Click a featured product to open its details
Verify product details are displayed

title: Proceed to checkout from product details
description: This test verifies that a shopper can move from product details into the checkout flow after choosing to buy.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Click a product card to open its details
Start checkout for the product
Verify the checkout flow is displayed

title: Complete checkout with Vodafone Cash
description: This verifies that a guest shopper can place an order using Vodafone Cash and receive the correct post-purchase state.

steps.description: Navigate to /checkout
Add a product to the cart from the shopping flow
Enter a full name
Enter a valid phone number
Enter a valid address
Select Vodafone Cash as the payment method
Submit the checkout form
Verify a payment-specific next-step message is visible
Verify the order is created successfully

title: Complete checkout with InstaPay
description: This verifies that a guest shopper can place an order using InstaPay and receive the correct post-purchase state.

steps.description: Navigate to /checkout
Add a product to the cart from the shopping flow
Enter a full name
Enter a valid phone number
Enter a valid address
Select InstaPay as the payment method
Submit the checkout form
Verify a payment-specific next-step message is visible
Verify the order is created successfully

title: Browse all active products from the products list
description: This test verifies that a guest shopper can browse the full active product list and open a product detail page from the grid.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Verify active products are displayed
Click a product card to open its details
Verify product details are displayed

title: Update cart item quantity and keep totals in sync
description: This verifies that a shopper can change the quantity of an item in the cart and see the cart totals update correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart
Add a product to the cart from the shopping flow
Change the quantity of the cart item to a valid higher value
Verify the cart reflects the updated item quantity
Verify the cart totals are recalculated

title: Require mandatory checkout fields before order creation
description: This verifies that checkout validation blocks submission when required customer details are missing.

steps.description: Navigate to /checkout
Add a product to the cart from the shopping flow
Leave the phone number field empty
Submit the checkout form
Verify a checkout validation error is visible
Verify the order is not created

title: Remove an item from the cart
description: This verifies that a shopper can remove a cart item and the cart updates to the expected remaining state.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart
Add two different products to the cart from the shopping flow
Remove one cart item
Verify the removed item no longer appears in the cart
Verify the remaining cart state is displayed

title: View product details with reviews and purchase actions
description: This test verifies that a shopper can open a product details page and see the information needed to decide to buy.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Click a product card to open its details
Verify product information is displayed
Verify reviews are displayed

title: Keep cart contents after returning to the cart page
description: This verifies that items previously added to the cart remain visible when the shopper returns to the cart page.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart
Add a product to the cart from the shopping flow
Leave the cart page and return to it
Verify the previously added item is still in the cart
Verify the cart state is preserved

title: Prevent checkout from an empty cart
description: This verifies that a shopper cannot proceed to checkout without items in the cart.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart
Ensure the cart is empty
Attempt to proceed to checkout
Verify an empty cart message is visible
Verify checkout is blocked

title: Show validation when adding an invalid cart item
description: This verifies that invalid cart input is rejected and the cart remains unchanged.

steps.description: Navigate to /cart
Attempt to add an item with a missing product selection
Attempt to add an item with an invalid quantity
Verify a cart validation error is visible
Verify the cart contents remain unchanged

title: Link an anonymous session to a customer after purchase
description: This verifies that an anonymous shopper can complete a purchase and the session is linked to the customer by phone number.

steps.description: Navigate to /checkout
Browse products as an anonymous visitor
Add a product to the cart from the shopping flow
Enter a full name
Enter a valid phone number
Enter a valid address
Select cash on delivery as the payment method
Submit the checkout form
Verify the order confirmation is visible
Verify the customer session linkage is reflected after purchase

title: Handle inactive or deleted product access from the products list
description: This test verifies that opening an inactive or deleted product results in a blocked state that prevents shopping actions.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Click a product card that resolves to an inactive or deleted product
Verify a product error state is displayed
Verify add to cart and buy now actions are unavailable

title: Handle invalid featured product access
description: This test verifies that opening an invalid featured product leads to a blocked product error state instead of a usable detail page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a featured product entry that resolves to an invalid product
Verify a product error state is displayed
Verify add to cart and buy now actions are unavailable

title: See product details error state for an invalid product id
description: This test verifies that an invalid product id shows a blocked product state and prevents shopping actions.

steps.description: Navigate to /products
Click a product entry that resolves to an invalid product id
Verify a product error state is displayed
Verify add to cart and buy now actions are unavailable
